technicalExport: Windows System.Drawing: HighQualityBicubic reduction of unchanged generated masters to 16x16 Format32bppArgb; SourceCopy compositing preserves transparency. The checked-in 16x16 sprites are the build inputs.

images.name: normal
images.prompt: Create a single original pixel-art minimap icon for a dark fantasy action RPG, visually at home in Hero Siege. Use case: stylized-concept. This is a production tiny game sprite, NOT a concept painting. Square canvas with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no background colour, no checkerboard drawn into image. Center ONE icon in frame, about 80% of canvas width/height. Design on an extremely coarse 16 by 16 logical pixel grid, enlarged crisply with hard square pixel edges, no antialiasing or glow blur. Chunky readable silhouette, near-black one-logical-pixel outer border, 4-6 opaque colours including bright highlights, few large details. It must read clearly at 16px. No text, no lettering, no frame, no UI, no shadow outside sprite, no extra objects. Subject: front-facing simple ivory bone skull, round dome, two large dark square eye holes, short squared jaw with two teeth. Ivory and warm bone highlights, dark brown shadows. Unadorned, easily readable common enemy emblem.
